name: aspen
description: Developer workflow skills for customizing the Aspen Platform with the aspen CLI. Ships using-aspen (discover the CLI and drive the build loop), read-metadata (read the instance's model as the source of truth), map-model (one subagent per component type), verify-change (prove a change works; writes are human-approved) and diagnose (reproduce before fixing), plus hooks that keep a Markdown digest of the instance's metadata current and ask before commands that reach the shared dev set or write records.
